name: buildreel
description: Sends a Buildreel update at the end of each work session, and offers a video only for a core feature or new main screen, without being asked. Works in projects set up for Buildreel (a "## Buildreel" section in CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md). Offers a post with a one-tap Yes / Not now card at good moments (at most once a chat). Keeps your token card up to date by itself: after chats it sends your AI token counts (numbers only, never chat text).
